appraisal_events.evidence: « Je suis désolée, un contretemps m'empêche de dîner ce soir avec vous à l'île du Bois. Je m'en faisais une fête. Je vous écrirai plus longuement de Stermaria. Regrets. Amitiés. » Je restai immobile, étourdi par le choc que j'avais reçu.
appraisal_events.explanation: After days of anticipation, Mme de Stermaria cancels the dinner by note at the last moment; the narrator is explicitly stunned, likening the impact to a physical blow, and the passage closes on his sense of a coming winter imprisonment.

status_effects.explanation: Days of built-up anticipation are abruptly cut off; the narrator is described as stunned by the cancellation, unable to redirect his desire, and closes the passage with an image of confinement.
By unilaterally withdrawing from the planned evening with only a brief note of regret, she controls the outcome of the anticipated encounter, leaving the narrator with no recourse.
